title: Chintamani Library v2.8.20 — Live 3D Holographic Card & Universal Portal Sync
releaseNotes: Live 3D Holographic Emblem: Beautiful floating 3D logo with interactive perspective tilt and specular lighting.
Rebuilt Update Card: Clean, clutter-free design featuring only the changes list and seamless 1-tap Update action.
Universal QR & Admin Portal Sync: Real-time synchronization of Admissions, Payments, and Complaints across all branches.
Admin Action Enhancements: Instant 1-tap approval for admissions, receipt verification, and complaint resolution.
